metadata.name: GetDisputeDetails
metadata.description: Use this API to fetch the Dispute Transaction Details.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CaseID
request_fields.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:9856198 Condition: At least one of Case ID or TransactionID is required. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Example:147852369 Condition: At least one of Case ID or TransactionID is required. Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Valid alues: 0-9 Example: 147852369

children.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
children.description: Transaction Currency Code Valid Values:0-9 Example:840 Appendix Section: Refer Appendix Section: Primary Currency Code

children.name: MerchantName
children.description: Name of the merchant and its location from where the transaction initiated

children.name: Association
children.description: Name of network of transaction. Example: Visa, MasterCard, Discover, Pulse, Star

children.name: TransactionDate
children.description: Date of  transaction posted on account Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: CaseID
children.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:9856198

children.name: ReasonCodeCategory
children.description: Reason Code Category for Dispute. Please refer appendix Section : Reason Code Category

children.name: ReasonCode
children.description: Reason Code for Dispute. Please refer appendix Section : Reason Code

children.name: ChargebackType
children.description: Chargeback Type shows the Dispute Amount is Full or Partial. Example: 1 = Full and 2 = partial

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: Disputed amount on the card. Example:600.30

children.name: CaseStatus
children.description: Shows the current case status.

children.name: NoteReason
children.description: Predefined Memo Reasons. Please refer appendix Section : Memo Reason

children.name: Notes
children.description: Notes entered by the user Valid Values : A-Z,0-9, special characters Example : Dispute Raised

children.name: DisputeStatusDescription
children.description: Shows the current dispute status.

children.name: DisputeResolveAmount
children.description: The amount for which dispute is resolved. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example: 300

children.name: DisputeInitiationDate
children.description: Date on which dispute is raised for the transaction. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 08:25:54

children.name: DisputeClosedDate
children.description: Date on which dispute is closed for the transaction. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 08:25:54

children.name: DisputeStage
children.description: Stage of Dispute case. Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Example: Initiate Dispute

children.name: ProvisionalCredit
children.description: Provisional Credit is provided to Cardholder or not Valid Values: 0 and 1 Format:X Example:0 = No ,1= Yes

children.name: ProvisionalCreditReversal
children.description: Provisional Credit reversal is done on Cardholder account or not Valid Values: 0 and 1 Format:X Example:0 = No ,1= Yes

children.name: ProvisionalCreditAmount
children.description: Provisional Credit amount Provided to Cardholder Valid Values: 0 to 9 Format:XXX Example:$15

children.name: ProvisionalCreditReversalAmount
children.description: Provisional Credit reversal amount Valid Values: 0 to 9 Format:XXX Example:$15

children.name: FraudLabel
children.description: Fraud Label of a Transaction. Valid Value:- 1 - Fraudulent 0 - Not Fraudulent Example:- 1
